title: Anthropic publishes the full constitution used to shape Claude
friendlyTitle: Anthropic shares the rules meant to guide Claude
summary: Anthropic published Claude’s constitution in full under a CC0 licence, describing the intended priorities behind the model’s behaviour: broad safety, ethics, compliance with guidelines and genuine helpfulness. Anthropic says the document directly informs training while acknowledging that model behaviour may not always match those intentions.
friendlySummary: Claude’s constitution explains the values and priorities Anthropic wants the model to follow. The full document is free for anyone to read and reuse.
whyItMatters: Users and developers now have a primary reference for the values and trade-offs Anthropic intends Claude to follow. It does not prove how Claude behaves in every case, but it makes the design target open to inspection and comparison with actual outcomes.
friendlyWhyItMatters: People can compare Claude’s real behaviour with the company’s stated goals. This makes the model’s intended rules easier to understand and question.
